fusions.name: Whaler's Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a chained harpoon at an enemy up to 8 tiles away for 7 damage, up to 2 times that at full range, and the target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Staked Lines
fusions.desc: Looses 3 chain-bolts in a spread out to 9 tiles, each dealing 26 damage that ignores armour, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Across
fusions.desc: Strings a taut chain 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
